pr_title: fix: collect all necessary setters of html elements
pr_body:
When spreading attributes, the setters of the element are checked. If they contain the key in question, it's set via that setter. For certain setters on certain elements this didn't work because the element prototype was not HTMLElement, rather a descendant of that (for example HTMLDivElement), which meant that only the setters of the descendant, not the superclass were taken into account. This fixes that by walking up the prototype chain until we find the Element prototype.

fixes #11179

``` When `isHidden` changes, `hidden` becomes `"false"`, which is still hidden. If you remove the spread obj. from the attributes, if `hidden` is `false`, it's removed from the attributes, making the element visible. ```svelte
``` So the issue is around the inconsistencies, as well as the type Svelte expects for the `hidden` attribute, which is currently `boolean | null | undefined`, but should be `string | null | undefined`. ### Reproduction [REPL](https://svelte-5-preview.vercel.app/#H4sIAAAAAAAAE42QQU7DQAxFr-JaSE2lpgjYhSQSN2DPsAgZNxl1OhONnVYoyi1YsOuGA_YIaJoKugCpO_tb_78vD7g2lhizlwFdtSXM8KnrcIny3sWFd2SFcIns-1BHJec6mE7AVq4pFAorLJVTYkmgNVqTgwJuWCqhREJPi0fl4r32jgUCsTwH3zEUMERZidEZzO_uH-ZxHZXLbydCefK5_K0X8Q68q62pN8WQLKAof1GzaRpPJcQ3jaXzMUZN5lNUPktTkNYwaE_sBPY-bOB4-PyANC2Vy7XZwbBarX46juegYrhktGStj2arIdkbaYG7QJWGSiTwIlK12f2BBGl937RwPHxdIq9i-F7-w-ASt16btSGNWfz4-Dp-A9pt_gzXAQAA) ### Logs _No response_ ### System Info ```shell Svelte 5 REPL environment ``` ### Severity annoyance
comments:
[`hidden` is not a boolean attribute](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/interaction.html#the-hidden-attribute), it a) probably should not be treated like a boolean attribute and b) might still need some special attention.

These are valid:
```html
<div hidden > <!-- same as hidden="hidden" -->
<div hidden=""> <!-- same as hidden="hidden" -->
<div hidden="hidden">
<div hidden="until-found">
```

Toggling between `"hidden"` and `undefined` [works](https://svelte-5-preview.vercel.app/#H4sIAAAAAAAACo2Oz2qEMBCHX2UYCiqIpe3NGkvfoPemB2tGN2w2CcnoUsR3L9H9cyr0NDM_Zr5vFhy0oYj154K2OxHW-O49lsg_Pg1xJsOEJUY3hT4lTeyD9gyms6OQyFFiK61kQwwHrRRZEPAQuWPKsz3Iildp007vbGQIFPkjOB9BwJJiyVrVkD09v2RpXKVtHndLu93Z5ntidhac7Y3uj2LJCxDtXXdtBFyN8AaTVTRoSwrqW7xur7IbR0OXqyTb8ZusUXqGpaqq25frZVEse90ZBzLGwdkFoyA_az5A9IE6BR1ziEWiKj3fkf9iuIn_wmCJJ6f0oElhzWGi9Wv9BWKQph-9AQAA).
Toggling between `""` and `undefined` [does not quite work](https://svelte-5-preview.vercel.app/#H4sIAAAAAAAACo2OzU6FMBCFX2UyMSkkBKPukGJ8A_fWBdIBmtvbknbgxhDe3RSu3pWJq5kzP985K_bGUsTqfUXXngkrfJ0mLJC_piTiQpYJC4x-Dl2a1LELZmKwrRukQo4KG-UUW2IYjdbkQMJd5JYpEyJ_Vi5tO-8iQ6DIb8FPESSsaazY6ArEw-OTSHJTrr4_-M3-5-rPmdk78K6zpjvJNctBNjejn0aCEPACs9PUG0caKhBi24OxHwZL18tkcCB3g1qbBdayLH-TbddDuR71YIxkrYeLD1ZDdjE8QpwCtRpa5hDzRNVmuSH_xfAz_4XBAs9em96QxorDTNvH9g3d5AiCqwEAAA==).

Understood @brunnerh, thanks for the clarification! I guess what is confusing is that the second `div` in my repl would lead one to believe that it does work that way... until you try to spread some additional attributes and it suddenly stops working that way!

The attribute is also typed in Svelte as `boolean | null | undefined`, so unless you're in a REPL it's unlikely you'd ever even try using a string.
@brunnerh currently, the TS type for the `hidden` property is `boolean | null | undefined`

`until-found` is fairly new and not even supported in many browsers.
Sometimes boolean attributes just somehow turn into enumerations 😅.
FWIW the same happens in Svelte 4
